import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    poly_T = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]*T**2
    log_T = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]*T**2
    lin = p[6] + p[7]*T
    return -eps*(poly_T + log_T*np.log(eps) + lin*eps)

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    lin = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]*T**2 + p[3]*T**3
    q = p[4] + p[5]*T
    lg = p[6] + p[7]*T + p[8]*T**2
    return -(eps*lin + q*eps**2 + eps*lg*np.log(eps))
